title: VanillaSuper
description: VanillaSuper is a private vanilla Minecraft server with a small but friendly community of players.
body:
# 🌿 VanillaSuper — Premium Private Vanilla Experience

**VanillaSuper** is a private, whitelist-only Minecraft server dedicated to a high-quality vanilla experience. We focus on building a small, friendly, and mature community where players can collaborate and create without the clutter of unnecessary plugins.

Whether you are a technical mastermind or a creative builder, you'll find a stable, optimized, and secure home here on **version 1.21.11**.

---

### 🔗 Useful Links

Stay connected with our development and community:

* **[Telegram](https://t.me/vanillasuper_ru)** — *Latest news, dev logs & updates*
* **[Discord](https://dsc.gg/vanillasuper)** — *Community chat and support*
* **[Wiki](https://wiki.vanillasuper.xyz)** — *Server rules, mechanics & guides*

---

### ⚙️ Technical Details

* **Server IP:** `vanillasuper.xyz`
* **Version:** `1.21.11` (Java Edition)
* **Platform:** High-performance Leaf (Paper-based)
* **Gameplay:** Pure Vanilla / Private

---
*Created with focus on stability and community.*
